text:
Sam Carter: Heads-up — discovered two tenant backfills routed to general pool during surge. Caused 60s p99 on normal inference paths for 20m.
Maya Chen: ouch. which routing rule failed?
Sam Carter: looks like the policy fallback hit when DedicatedPool was at cap. API call used priority=high but the router dropped to 'best-effort' because slot lease timed out.
Devon Patel: can you paste the request payload?
Sam Carter: here —
```json
POST /v1/backfills
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_43df",
  "window": "2026-03-19T00:00:00Z/2026-03-20T00:00:00Z",
  "priority": "high"
}
```
Maya Chen: router uses priority -> lane mapping, but lease timeout is what triggers fallback. We currently have two fallback modes: spill-to-general and queue-wait. For US-west surge it's spilling.
Liz Ortega: UX asks: should console show "guaranteed routing" vs "best-effort" before submit? Product wants a single checkbox for guaranteed (consumes reserved tokens).
Devon Patel: agreed. Implementation options: (A) add required quota debit at submit time and reject if reserved capacity insufficient; (B) accept and probabilistically route with best-effort fallback but show risk.
Maya Chen: (A) is safer but will block many small backfills and lead to support churn. (B) is friendlier but we need clearer telemetry.
Sam Carter: we need middle ground: opt-in guaranteed lane that debits backfill_quota and surfaces a routing token id. Without it, calls get a routing_score and can be preempted.
ReplayBot: alert: backfill acct_43df spilled to general pool at 2026-03-19T14:12:04Z — latency bump detected.
OpsBot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/backfill-fallback-runbook
Maya Chen: telemetry ask: console backfill page should show three metrics per job: routing_mode (guaranteed|best-effort|queued), routing_token, and estimated_cost_saved_by_batching. Also a live trace of which pool served tokens.
Liz Ortega: UI mock: small badge next to submit: [Guaranteed (uses reserved quota)] with hover explaining cost. Also a progress bar with colored sections showing "dedicated", "fallback", "queued".
Devon Patel: API proposal: extend backfill create with routing_policy object:
```json
{
  "routing_policy": { "mode": "guaranteed", "quota_token": "string(optional)" }
}
```
Sam Carter: and a /v1/backfills/:id/routing_status endpoint returning current_pool, lease_expiry, routing_score.
Maya Chen: we need a server-side change: when mode=guaranteed debit reserved_backfill_quota immediately and pin job to dedicated slot; if debit fails return 409 with estimated available time.
Devon Patel: rebalance: add a circuit that prevents dedicated-pool eviction of normal inference if too many guaranteed backfills start. Dedicated must be separate capacity class not to starve online SLO.
Liz Ortega: product question: do we expose reserved quota to org admins or only via invoices? Product wants admin controls in console + policy enforcement for org-level quotas.
Sam Carter: yes, admin page with adjustable reserved_backfill_quota and current usage. Also invite flow to request quota increases.
Maya Chen: telemetry dashboard tasks:
- new metric: backfill_routing_mode_count (labels: tenant, mode)
- gauge: reserved_backfill_quota_{tenant}
- histogram: backfill_serve_pool_latency_seconds by pool_type
- event stream: routing_decision_events to trace each job lifecycle
Devon Patel: can we reprocess the last 24h to compute how many jobs would have failed under mode=guaranteed? Need that to size default quotas.
Sam Carter: yep. I'll kick a replay with a filter that simulates debit checks. Dev, can you reserve a small env pool to canary?
Devon Patel: on it — creating dedicated test pool dpool-canary-3 (4xA10G). Will pin one tenant for experiment.
ReplayBot: scheduled replay: job simulate-debit-check-1749998889 started.
Maya Chen: next steps:
- Dev to provision test pool (ETA 2h)
- Sam to run replay-sim and produce estimate table for default quotas
- Liz to produce console mock and copy for admin flow
- Engineering to draft API schema PR and run a spec review
Sam Carter: I'll post the replay output once done. If numbers show >10% jobs blocked with reasonable quotas, we'll need a grace flow.
Liz Ortega: can we put a temporary banner in console warning during rollout: "Backfill routing behavior changing next week — guaranteed option coming"
Maya Chen: +1. Also add a flag in the console to opt-in for the test tenant.
Devon Patel: noted. I'll update routing logs to include routing_token and make sure we emit a sampling of full decision payloads to the event stream.
Sam Carter: thanks all. I'll follow up in ~3h with numbers.
Liz Ortega: thanks! :thumbsup:
